units.source_text: 将近黎明，八亲王上佛堂去做功课了。

en.t: Toward dawn, the Eighth Prince went up to the Buddha hall to perform his devotions.

units.source_text: 薰君便召唤那个老侍女来谈话。

en.t: Kaoru then summoned the old gentlewoman and spoke with her.

units.source_text: 这老侍女是服侍两位女公子的，名叫弁君，年纪将近六十，然而态度优雅，善于应对。

en.t: This old gentlewoman served the two young ladies; her name was Ben no Kimi, and though she was nearly sixty, her manner was graceful and she answered with skill.

units.source_text: 她叙述已故柏木权大纳言日夜忧愁，以致一病不起之状，哭泣不已。

en.t: She described how the late Kashiwagi, the Provisional Major Counselor, had grieved day and night until he fell ill and never rose again, and she could not stop weeping.

units.source_text: 薰君想道：“此种往事，即使是关于他人的，听了也不胜感慨。

en.t: Kaoru thought, "Even when old matters like this concern someone else, hearing them is deeply moving.

units.source_text: 何况是我本人多年以来所渴望知道的。

en.t: How much more so when it is something I myself have longed for years to know.

units.source_text: 我常向佛祈愿，欲请明示当时发生何种事情，致使吾母出家为尼。

en.t: I have often prayed to the Buddha to reveal what happened then, and what led my mother to become a nun.

units.source_text: 想是佛力应验，使我无意中得此机会，听到这如梦一般可悲的故事。”

en.t: Surely the Buddha's power has answered me, giving me this chance by accident to hear a sorrowful story like a dream."

units.source_text: 他的眼泪就流个不住。

en.t: His tears flowed without stopping.

units.source_text: 后来说道：“如此看来， 像你一样知道当年旧事的人，现今世间还有。

en.t: After a while he said, "So there are still people in the world, like you, who know the old events of those days.

units.source_text: 但不知这种可惊又可耻的事，另外还有人传播出去否？

en.t: But I wonder whether anyone else has spread abroad this shocking and shameful matter.

units.source_text: 多年以来，我全然不曾听到呢。”

en.t: For all these years, I have never heard a word of it."

units.source_text: 弁君答道：“除了小侍从和我弁君之外，没有第三人知道。

en.t: Ben no Kimi answered, "Apart from Ko Jijuu and me, Ben no Kimi, no third person knew it.

units.source_text: 我们两人一句话也不曾向人泄露过。

en.t: The two of us never leaked even a single word to anyone.

units.source_text: 我虽身份低微、毫不足道，却蒙权大纳言垂青，幸得朝夕侍奉在侧。

en.t: Though I was low in rank and of no account, the Provisional Major Counselor favored me, and I was fortunate enough to serve at his side morning and evening.

units.source_text: 因此种种详情，皆得目见耳闻。

en.t: For that reason, I saw and heard all sorts of details myself.

units.source_text: 权大纳言每逢胸中苦闷不堪之时，只唤我们两人偶尔传送书信。

en.t: Whenever the Provisional Major Counselor could no longer bear the anguish in his heart, he would call only the two of us to carry letters from time to time.

units.source_text: 关于此种事情，我实不敢多嘴，恕不详述了。

en.t: About such matters, I truly dare not say too much, so please forgive me for not going into detail.

units.source_text: 权大纳言临终之际，对我略有遗言吩咐。

en.t: At the time of his death, the Provisional Major Counselor left me a few last instructions.

units.source_text: 我此微贱之身，其实不胜重托。

en.t: For a humble person like me, the charge was truly too heavy to bear.

units.source_text: 因此常挂心头，考虑有何办法可将遗言向您传达。

en.t: So I always kept it in my heart and wondered how I might convey his last words to you.

units.source_text: 当我一知半解地诵经念佛的时候，也常以此事向佛祈愿。

en.t: Even when I recited sutras and invoked the Buddha with my poor understanding, I often prayed to the Buddha about this matter.

units.source_text: 如今果然应验，可见世界上佛菩萨到底是有的，真使我感谢不尽。

en.t: Now it has truly been answered, and I see that Buddhas and bodhisattvas really do exist in this world; my gratitude is endless.

units.source_text: 尚有一物，非请您看不可。

en.t: There is one more thing that I must ask you to see.

units.source_text: 以前我曾经想：如今有何办法呢？

en.t: Before, I once thought, what can be done now?

units.source_text: 不如把它烧毁了吧。

en.t: Perhaps it would be better to burn it.

units.source_text: 我身朝不保夕，万一死去，此物安得不落入别人手中呢？

en.t: My life is uncertain from one day to the next; if I should die, how could this thing fail to fall into someone else's hands?

units.source_text: 我一直如此担心。

en.t: I have worried about that all along.

units.source_text: 后来看见您常到这里的亲王家来，我想我可静待机会，稍稍有了希望。

en.t: Later, when I saw you often coming here to the prince's house, I thought I could quietly wait for an opportunity, and I felt a little hope.

units.source_text: 便有勇气忍耐，果然等着今天这良机。

en.t: That gave me the courage to endure, and at last I have waited until this good chance today.

units.source_text: 这实在是前世注定的事啊！”

en.t: This must truly have been destined from a former life!"

units.source_text: 便啼啼哭哭地详细回忆薰君诞生时的情状，一一奉告。

en.t: Then, sobbing as she spoke, she recalled in detail the circumstances of Kaoru's birth and told him everything one by one.

units.source_text: 又说：“权大纳言逝世之后，我母忽然患病，不久也就死去。

en.t: She went on, "After the Provisional Major Counselor died, my mother suddenly fell ill and soon died as well.

units.source_text: 我加倍伤心，穿了两重丧服，日夜悲痛愁叹。

en.t: My grief was doubled; I wore mourning twice over and spent day and night in sorrow and lamentation.

units.source_text: 正在此时，有一个不良之人，多年来对我用心，就用甜言蜜语把我骗到手，

en.t: Just then, a bad man who had pursued me for years used sweet words to deceive me and win me over,

units.source_text: 带着我到西海尽头的住地去了。

en.t: and he took me away to his dwelling at the far end of the western sea.

units.source_text: 于是京中情状，全然断绝消息。

en.t: After that, all news of what was happening in the capital was completely cut off.

units.source_text: 后来这个人也在住地死去。

en.t: Later, that man too died in the place where we lived.

units.source_text: 我离京十有余年，一旦重返故土，恍如到了另一世界。

en.t: After being away from the capital for more than ten years, when I finally returned to my old home, it felt as if I had come to another world.

units.source_text: 这里的亲王是我父亲的外甥女婿，我从小常在他家出入，我想来依附他。

en.t: The prince here is married to my father's niece, and since I had often come and gone in his household from childhood, I thought I would depend on him.

units.source_text: 又念我身今已不能参与侍女之列，冷泉院弘徽殿女御自昔与我稔熟，

en.t: I also thought that, since I could no longer take my place among the gentlewomen, and since the Kokiden Consort of Reizei-in had long been familiar with me,

units.source_text: 应该去依附她。

en.t: I ought to go and rely on her.

units.source_text: 然而颇觉不好意思，终于不曾去见，就变成了隐没在深山中的朽木。

en.t: Yet I felt too ashamed and in the end never went to see her, becoming like a rotten log hidden deep in the mountains.

units.source_text: 小侍从不知几时死的。

en.t: I do not know when Ko Jijuu died.

units.source_text: 当年青春少女，现已大半凋零。

en.t: The young girls of those days have now mostly withered away.

units.source_text: 我这老命在许多人死后残生于世，实甚可悲，

en.t: This old life of mine has lingered on after so many others have died, and it is truly sad,

units.source_text: 偏偏又不肯死，还在这里苟延残喘。”

en.t: yet perversely I will not die, and I am still here, barely dragging out my breath."

units.source_text: 谈谈说说之间，天色已经大明。

en.t: While they talked on and on, the sky had grown fully bright.

units.source_text: 薰君道：“罢了！

en.t: Kaoru said, "Enough!

units.source_text: 这些旧事真是说不完的。

en.t: There is truly no end to these old matters.

units.source_text: 以后找个不须防人听见的时候，再和你畅谈吧。

en.t: Later, when there is no need to fear anyone overhearing us, I will speak with you at length again.

units.source_text: 我隐约记得，那个小侍从是在我五六岁时突然患了心病而死的。

en.t: I vaguely remember that Ko Jijuu suddenly fell ill with a sickness of the heart and died when I was five or six.

units.source_text: 我倘不得和你会面，则将负着重罪过此一生了！”

en.t: If I had not been able to meet you, I would have gone through this life bearing a heavy sin!"

units.source_text: 弁君掏出一只小小的袋子来，袋内装着的是许多已经发霉了的信件。

en.t: Ben no Kimi took out a very small bag, and inside it were many letters that had already grown moldy.

units.source_text: 她把袋子交与薰君，对他言道：“这个请您看后烧毁吧。

en.t: She handed the bag to Kaoru and said to him, "Please look at these and then burn them.

units.source_text: 那时权大纳言对我说：‘我的生命已无望了。’

en.t: At that time the Provisional Major Counselor said to me, 'There is no longer any hope for my life.'

units.source_text: 便把这些信件收集起来，交付给我。

en.t: Then he gathered these letters together and entrusted them to me.

units.source_text: 我打算在再见小侍从时交给她，托她妥为转奉，却想不到和她永别了。

en.t: I meant to give them to Ko Jijuu when I saw her again and ask her to pass them on properly, but I never imagined I would be parted from her forever.

units.source_text: 我非常悲恸，不仅为了我和她的私交，又为了辜负权大纳言的嘱托。”

en.t: I was terribly grieved, not only because of my private bond with her, but also because I had failed the Provisional Major Counselor's charge."

units.source_text: 薰君装作若无其事地收了这些信，把它藏入怀里。

en.t: Kaoru accepted the letters as if nothing were the matter and hid them inside his robe.

units.source_text: 他想：“这种老婆子，会不会把这件事当作世间的珍闻而不问自述地向人泄露呢？”

en.t: He thought, "Might an old woman like this treat the matter as a rare tale for the world and leak it to others without being asked?"

units.source_text: 便很担心。

en.t: He was therefore very worried.

units.source_text: 但弁君几次三番向他立誓，说“决不向人泄露”。

en.t: But Ben no Kimi swore to him again and again, saying, "I will never reveal it to anyone."

units.source_text: 他又觉得或许此言可信，心神疑惑不定。

en.t: He also felt that perhaps her words could be trusted, and his mind wavered in uncertainty.

units.source_text: 早餐时薰君吃了些粥和糯米饭团，准备告辞。

en.t: At breakfast, Kaoru ate a little porridge and some glutinous rice balls, then prepared to take his leave.

units.source_text: 对八亲王说：“昨日是朝廷假日。

en.t: He said to the Eighth Prince, "Yesterday was a court holiday.

units.source_text: 今日禁中斋戒已毕，冷泉院的大公主患病，我必须去慰问。

en.t: Today the abstinence observances in the palace are over, and Reizei-in's eldest princess is ill, so I must go to pay a visit of sympathy.

units.source_text: 因有种种事情，不得空闲。

en.t: With various matters to attend to, I have no leisure.

units.source_text: 且待诸事办了以后，山中红叶未落之前，当再前来叩访。”

en.t: Once everything is settled, before the mountain's red leaves have fallen, I shall come to call on you again."

units.source_text: 八亲王欣然答道：“如此屡蒙赏光，可使山居蓬荜生辉。”

en.t: The Eighth Prince answered gladly, "If you honor me with such frequent visits, you will make this mountain dwelling shine."
